text:
Tess Nguyen: Quick heads-up — DevTown is next Tue. Final checklist for booth + speaking track. Need confirmations on swag arrival, speaker slides, and QR lead routing. Short thread so we can close.
Sam Patel: On swag: vendor updated ETA to Mon 2pm. Tracking: UPS 1Z999. :package:
Ben Ortiz: Can you paste the SKU list? I want to confirm sizes for tees.
Tess Nguyen: SKU list: `RW-TEE-1..RW-TEE-5`, `RW-STICKER-2`, `RW-POSTCARD-BENCH`. Most common sizes are M/L. We pulled last-event data — 60% M.
Elaine Park: We should set aside at least 20 XLs and 10 S. We ran out of S at last booth. :eyes:
Sam Patel: Noted. I'll add a buffer. @Logistics Ops any chance we can expedite small box with 30 tees if UPS is delayed?
Logistics Ops: Possible but adds ~$120 to courier. ETA guaranteed by end of day Monday with express.
Ben Ortiz: Budget ok for express if it prevents scrambling. What's the final swag spend vs approved? I have $3.2k left in the event budget.
Tess Nguyen: Express + extra tees fits within that. Final estimate: swag + shipping = ~$2.7k. Still under.
Sam Patel: Speaking side — keynote slides due EOD Sunday. Who's uploading? @Tess
Tess Nguyen: I'll upload to the speaker repo at `drive/redwood/events/devtown/slides`. Please name slides `lastname_devtown_v1.pdf`.
Elaine Park: Also remind speakers to include 2–3 benchmark callouts on slide 3 (latency/cost comparison) — marketing wants the one-liner for social posts.
Ben Ortiz: For benchmark postcards: front is visual, back has QR and 3 bullet points. Draft copy attached in drive.
Tess Nguyen: Important: QR routing plan — we want two landing flows depending on interest. Mapping below:
qr.dev/redwood → landing -> choose: [Hosted API, Dedicated, Private]
if click Hosted API -> /signup?src=devtown&flow=hosted
if click Dedicated/Private -> capture lead + route to AE queue (tag:dedicated)
DevRel Bot: Reminder set — create AE queue tag `devtown-dedicated` and webhook for new leads. :robot_face:
Sam Patel: Can we capture which postcard they scanned (bench vs demo) for A/B follow-up?
Tess Nguyen: Yes — we'll include `?variant=bench` or `?variant=demo` in the QR. That gets passed to the CRM field `event_variant`.
Elaine Park: Also include an opt-in checkbox copy: "Send me Redwood performance tips and event follow-ups." Must be default unchecked.
Ben Ortiz: On staffing: need 2 people on demo station at all times, 1 for lead capture, 1 floater. Tess — can you confirm the roster?
Tess Nguyen: Roster: Sam (morning demos), Ben (afternoon demos), Elaine (lead capture shifts), + Hannah from SDRs for float. I'll post a google sheet with shifts.
Logistics Ops: Table and charger order confirmed. We'll bring a small UPS power brick and extra HDMI adapter kit. :+1:
Sam Patel: Last item — swag table signage. Elaine, can you finalize artwork for the sticker wall and postcard stand?
Elaine Park: Will do tonight. Uploading proofs to drive and Slack here.
Ben Ortiz: One last ask — speaking submission changed: our panel time moved 30m earlier. Can we notify registrants with new time and updated slide deadline?
Tess Nguyen: Done. I'll ping attendees and update the event page. Quick copy for message: "Panel moved to 10:30am — please have slides uploaded by EOD Sun." Anyone want to tweak?
Sam Patel: Good.
Tess Nguyen: Cool — if no objections I'll close action items and confirm orders by 5pm. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
